A network with a billion dials gets one answer wrong. Which dial do you blame?
Testing every dial one by one would outlast the universe. So AI cheats, cleverly.
First, the forward pass: the input flows through the layers, and out comes a guess.
It guessed cat. The picture was a dog. That gap is the error.
Now backpropagation: the error flows backward, from the output toward the input.
At each layer, the chain rule from calculus asks: how much did you add to this mistake?
Dials that pushed the wrong way take the blame. Dials that barely mattered take almost none.
Each dial nudges a tiny step, and one backward sweep scores all billion at once.
Repeat millions of times, and random numbers learn to see. Latoon. Voyaging the unseen. Follow for more.
